profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Backend Systems · Data Engineering | Python · TypeScript · SQL · AWS
profile.summary: Software engineer with a deep focus in backend systems and data engineering, and a genuine belief that good backend work requires understanding the full stack. Before tech, I studied abstract mathematics, published a math paper, and contributed to college-level math textbooks. For the past decade, I've been building software in computational biology and financial services: fields where the technical problems are tangled up in domain complexity, and the best engineering requires real collaboration with scientists, product managers, and business teams. That's the work I like best.
